gaps.sentence: The model predicts the weather with remarkable ___ (ACCURATE).
___ (FORTUNE), the package had already been delivered.
gaps.explanation: The sentence adverb is 'Fortunately' — luckily for us.

gaps.sentence: The plane made a hard but ___ (SUCCESS) landing.
The two sides failed to reach an ___ (AGREE).
The ___ (DECIDE) to close the factory was announced yesterday.

gaps.explanation: 'A tendency to do something' — noun from tend.

gaps.sentence: The delays have made the project far more ___ (COST) than planned.
gaps.explanation: 'Far more costly' — the comparative adjective is needed after 'more'.

gaps.sentence: The storm caused ___ (WIDE) damage along the coast.
gaps.explanation: 'Widespread damage' = damage across a large area.
